harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created Fleet Internal CA on node1, issued node2’s TLS certificate, configured persistent HTTPS on node2:8443, and installed the CA into both system trust stores. End-to-end HTTPS and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Created a 3072-bit Fleet Internal CA on node1 with its private key mode set to 0600.
Generated node2’s private key locally and issued a certificate containing DNS:node2 and IP:10.100.45.11 SANs.
Installed the CA into the CentOS system trust stores on node1 and node2.
Configured and enabled fleet-https.service on node2, listening on TCP port 8443.
Verified trusted HTTPS returns HTTP 200 locally and remotely without a custom CA override.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create Fleet Internal CA on node1
evidence.summary: Shows the exact CA subject, self-issued identity, stable fingerprint, matching key/certificate, and private-key mode 0600.

evidence.requirement: Issue a TLS certificate for node2
evidence.summary: Shows the CSR SANs, successful issuance by Fleet Internal CA, certificate validation, matching key, and final DNS/IP SANs.

evidence.requirement: Serve trusted HTTPS on node2 port 8443
evidence.summary: Shows the enabled/active service, 0.0.0.0:8443 listener, presented certificate identity, successful hostname validation, and HTTP 200.

evidence.requirement: Install the CA as a trusted system authority on both nodes
evidence.summary: Both CentOS system CA bundles validate the CA-issued leaf, and both hosts successfully access HTTPS without an explicit CA file.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID d4784d1b-162e-4faa-b581-f6427617d23c, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID c82ab007-b3a2-41f9-a232-d5c718393c6a, running state, preserved CA fingerprint, trust, and HTTP 200.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 984a7d52-3387-4830-a06e-15e8b5e6c2a1, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID fa6c295d-8cef-416d-9227-3f02da58defe, running state, recovered enabled/active service, listener, trust, stable certificate fingerprint, and HTTP 200.
